meta.name: lcx-contribute-bug-fix
meta.description: Contribute a verified bug fix for LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, bundled Codex skills, or upstream Codex CLI bugs. Opens a fork PR only for upstream openai/codex; LazyCodex-owned defects become a verified-fix issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR — that repo is a generated distribution mirror). Use when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, contribute to fix bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 LazyCodex 或 Codex 项目提交经过验证的缺陷修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 LazyCodex 或 Codex 并想贡献修复
copy.tagline_en: Submit a verified bug fix for LazyCodex or Codex projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and want to contribute a fix

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先复现你报的 LazyCodex 或 Codex 缺陷，在临时工作区里写最小修复并验证。上游 openai/codex 的问题提 fork PR；LazyCodex 自身的问题改为带补丁的 issue，不开 PR。
howto.when: 当你要求修复 bug、贡献 bug fix、为某个 bug 开 PR，或想调试 LazyCodex / Codex 的缺陷时接管。

say.text: 帮我修一下这个 LazyCodex 的 bug，先复现再给最小修复
say.note: 会产出内嵌补丁的 verified-fix issue

say.text: 这个 Codex CLI 的 bug 能复现，帮我开个 fork PR
say.note: 会 fork openai/codex 并提交 PR

say.text: 先复现这个缺陷，再补一个失败转通过的回归测试
say.note: 先写失败测试，再改代码

howto.what_en: Claude reproduces the reported LazyCodex or Codex defect, makes the smallest fix in a temp workspace, and verifies it. Upstream openai/codex bugs become a fork PR; LazyCodex defects become a patch-included issue, not a PR.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex or Codex defect.

say_en.text: Fix this LazyCodex bug: reproduce it first, then give the smallest fix.
say_en.note: Produces a verified-fix issue with the patch

say_en.text: This Codex CLI bug reproduces without LazyCodex; open a fork PR.
say_en.note: Forks openai/codex and opens a PR

say_en.text: Reproduce the defect, then add a test that fails before and passes after.
say_en.note: Writes a failing regression test first
